about: Front RU0: findings of the ru lint (src/i18n/lint/, profile ru) that are correct Russian in one string, each with a reason. Keys are the lint's string ids; `words` are the matched words allowed in that string only, `rules` whole rules, `placeholders` added placeholders.

catalog:lab.nav.reason: Review (RU0): every exercise guide in the menu reads «Руководство: <topic>», one pattern for all seven (the English says "lab guide" for two of them only)

catalog:pleiadesLab.nav.reason: Review (RU0): every exercise guide in the menu reads «Руководство: <topic>», one pattern for all seven (the English says "lab guide" for two of them only)

map:camera.citation.reason: a bibliographic citation: authors and catalogue names stay as published (Zacharias et al. 2004; Monet et al. 2003)

map:camera.citationIr.reason: a bibliographic citation: the survey's published name (Two Micron All Sky Survey) and authors stay as published

original:\" Not Found..reason: VIREO joins this piece after a name it opens with an untranslated straight " (another piece, VIREO's own), so the closing mark must stay a straight quote, as in pt and fr

original:fragment|You have not recorded.reason: VIREO closes this straight quote itself in a piece it never translates, so the opening mark must stay a straight quote, as in pt and fr

original:fragment|Meter Radio Telescope.reason: Russian puts the diameter inside the name («Радиотелескоп {diameter} м»), as es, pt and fr do

catalog:pa.legend.reason: Front RU4: «визуальные ориентиры» are guide lines drawn on the chart, not an exercise guide

map:radioAntenna.antenna.notice.title.qu.reason: Front RU5: the title of a question box, «Подтверждение», as VIREO's Confirmation caption in originals.json; «Подтвердить» is the button
